dataset.name: CoauthorPhysics
dataset.source_input: Permitted complete raw binary sparse X. No feature normalization or graph modifications in native layers.
dataset.development_boundary: Already encountered graph and fixed developmental role geometry. This is not unused confirmation.

baseline_reuse: P1/F1/I4/S4 may be reused only after ALL 30 active peer banks close, if root audits exact source/data/role/RNG/objective/selector/restore identities. No partial arm or metric can select continuation. Otherwise acquire the entire fixed roster after root admission.

tour_rule.preprocessing: Extract the undirected loop-free support for serialization only; require reciprocal native off-diagonal support and audit it without labels. Native adjacency/degrees remain byte-identical. Build stable sorted neighbor lists from the qualified graph, then independently shuffle root order and each adjacency list with a private CPU generator. Run iterative DFS; every discovery edge enters the spanning forest. Emit a node on first entry and after every child return. Traverse isolated nodes once. Start/reset each connected component separately.
tour_rule.sampling_law: Randomized DFS spanning forest, NOT a uniformly sampled spanning tree. No feature, degree priority, TRAIN label, SELECT/CAL truth, error or prediction influences ordering.
tour_rule.tour_seed: block + 337000031 + 1000003*m for m=0..3, private CPU generator, independent of all source/route dropout streams.
tour_rule.refresh: Draw exactly four tours once per block and persist them for all training, selection, CAL and serving. No resampling, extra inference tours or selected order.
tour_rule.length: L=sum_c(2*N_c-1)=2*N-C; C actual component count bound by root before construction. L <= 68985. Same C for all four tours.
tour_rule.node_readout: Every node appears. z_v is the arithmetic mean of bidirectional states at ALL its tour occurrences. Labels never enter this readout.
tour_rule.custody: Root must save graph/tour/offset/count payload hashes and full generator states before fits. This proposal has accessed no graph payload or tour array.
tour_rule.ID_equivariance_scope: Root/neighbor shuffles are applied to stable node-ID indexed lists. Under ideal independent uniform draws, the intended sampling law is symmetric under graph relabeling; a fixed finite seeded tour depends on node IDs and is not exactly equivariant per realization. No canonical ordering, uniform-spanning-tree law or finite-four-tour invariance is claimed. No label, prediction or error enters sampler. No extra ID experiment is included.
tour_rule.CPU_generator_draw_order: One injected torch.Generator(device=cpu) per block/tour, manually seeded from tour_seed. Save state before root draw. First torch.randperm(N,generator=g) gives root order. Then in ascending node-ID order v=0..N-1, torch.randperm(deg(v),generator=g) shuffles each stable sorted loop-free neighbor list, including empty lists. Save post-neighbor generator state. Iterative DFS/tour emission consumes no further randomness. Private generator never mutates source/global/dropout RNG.

scan.placement: After native first-layer clip and ReLU H_m; before native second-layer dropout/aggregate/skip.
scan.node_projection: u_v=tanh(H_v W_u + b_u); a_v=sigmoid(H_v W_a+b_a); q_v=(1-a_v)*u_v. Compute these once per NODE per route, then gather a_v,q_v at tour occurrences.
scan.recurrence: Forward and reverse within EACH component: s_t=a[v_t]*s_previous+q[v_t], s_initial=0. Both directions share W_u,W_a,b_u,b_a. z_v=mean_{t:v_t=v}(s_forward[t]+s_reverse[t])/2.
scan.residual: Hprime_v=clip_rows(H_v + 0.25*z_v*W_o), clip_rows(z)=z/max(||z||_2,1). No new bias, scan dropout or normalization.
scan.parameters: W_u,W_a,W_o each 32x32; b_u,b_a each32. Total3136. Shared in SW4/C4/R4; wholly private in each WI4 learner; all tied across V1 views. Only the existing native maps have private fast factors.
scan.initialization: W_u,W_a Glorot uniform with private CPU fork seed block+337000043+1000003*body_m; b_u=0; b_a=log(99) so initial retention .99; W_o=0. No scan draw perturbs source slow-weight, factor or persistent dropout streams. Zero residual preserves the corresponding no-scan native initial function in exact arithmetic; repeated clipping may introduce float roundoff and is not bitwise certification. Source trajectory still may change after the first update.
scan.memory_reset_control: R4 sets the incoming state to zero before every token, preserving u,a,q and W_o. In that arm each token state is q_v; node context becomes a pointwise nonlinear transform.
scan.implementation: Nominated practical source implementation: custom FIRST-ORDER autograd with vectorized doubling of affine pairs, storing original carry coefficients and states rather than an eager level tape. O(M*L*h*log L) tensor work, O(M*L*h) live/saved scan storage; no Python per-token CUDA loop, detached scientific state or dense N-by-N operator. Composition later∘earlier=(a_later*a_earlier,q_later+a_later*q_earlier). Component-start carry coefficient is0 but q remains unchanged. Reverse each component separately. Backward adjoint lambda_t=g_t+a[t+1]*lambda[t+1] with resets, dq_t=lambda_t, da_t=lambda_t*s[t-1], s_previous=0 at component starts. Autograd also propagates through q=(1-a)*u,node gathers/occurrence means,and all native layers. Higher-order derivatives are outside this source learner requirement. Implementation remains unqualified until root finite admission.
scan.reset_gradient_contract: Mask ONLY the recurrent carry coefficient at component starts. q=(1-a_orig)*u is formed from original learned sigmoid a before carry masking, so its gate/input gradients remain live. R4 resets every token in the same manner: s=q, preserving original gate inside q. Reverse adjoint stops cross-component carry. This is not detach of within-component states.

learning.source_authority: Reuse native source-derived meanSAGE core law and qualified V3 runtime owner after root admission; the current peer source is referenced, not edited or imported.
learning.native_law: Two meanSAGE layers8415→32→5. One p=.4 dropped native input feeds aggregate and skip at each layer; clip rows, first ReLU only, final logits clipped. Raw binary features and original graph. Each evaluation route has its own persistent source dropout stream; PV1/V1 views have distinct streams but ALL trainable parameters are tied.
learning.factor_law: W_eff=diag(r)*W*diag(s), independent learned native aggregate/skip factors each layer, Rademacher ±1 starts, private native biases. P1/PV1 ordinary matrices; F1/V1 one factor parameter set; SW4/C4/R4 four private sets. Native slow maps shared only in shared banks.
learning.loss: Mean own-route/view TRAIN CE plus mean source first-layer effective-weight penalty .05. V1 tied effective penalty counted once; P1/PV1 ordinary first-layer matrix penalty counted once. No pooled-loss objective, auxiliary contrast/diversity loss, scan penalty or scan optimizer.
learning.optimizer: Source TF1 Adam port LR.001, beta1.9,beta2.999,eps1e-8 before bias correction,float32 beta powers. Update all live parameters jointly once per own complete objective. Genuine I4/WI4 have FOUR separate objects/optimizers/selectors/stops.
learning.selector: Latest tied minimum total SELECT CE+native/effective L2 after each update;50 strictly worse successive totals or100000 update ceiling. Shared/tied banks use mean own total; genuine independent learners select independently. Restore complete model/optimizer/mode/global and route RNG.
learning.calibration: Freeze native serving mean_m softmax(member_logprob_m/T). Float64 CPU Adam LR.05,500 scalar steps,logTstart0,clamp[-5,5],latest tied minimum CAL NLL over steps0..500. PV1/V1's four outputs are views of one learner. Raw probability-mean argmax is primary. Never substitute the raw-logit sign-dropout reader.
learning.role_isolation: Only TRAIN truth reaches optimizer; SELECT selects model; CAL selects scalar temperature after selected-state restore; DEVELOPMENT_EVAL is opened only after complete fixed-family closure. No TEST, per-view order selector or horizon/parameter search.
learning.capable_reference_boundary: P1 is the demonstrated ordinary source learner. F1 is a different factorized optimization parameterization and is not assumed equally competent. PV1 gives the ordinary source the SAME four tours; V1 gives the factorized source the SAME four tours. WI4 remains the exactly equipped genuinely independent factorized counterpart. Report all seven quality references; do not select a weak reference.

gates.status: Proposed margins fixed in this packet; root scientific admission required before any fit. They are not retrospective claims.
gates.raw_utility: Across the three paired blocks, SW4 must exceed EACH of P1,F1,I4,S4,PV1,WI4,V1 by at least .20 percentage points in the mean and have strictly positive delta in every block.
gates.member_competence: SW4 mean member accuracy minus WI4 mean member accuracy >= -.25 points in the overall mean; no block below -.50. Also report all per-member paired deltas and source-I4 deltas.
gates.attribution: SW4 minus C4 and SW4 minus R4 each >= .10 points mean, strictly positive in every block. Failure against PV1 or V1 refutes private-member superiority over the corresponding equipped single; failure against C4 refutes the persistent-private-tour ingredient; failure against R4 refutes retained path state as the utility ingredient at this recipe. Passing this pilot does not answer the stronger16-view independently trained bank gap.
gates.confidence: Separate protection result: calibrated NLL no worse than each I4/WI4/PV1/V1 by >.005 nat in any block, and overall mean no worse than the best mean among those references. Accuracy-positive/confidence-negative remains exactly that, not a protected-confidence claim.
gates.cost: Report measured full paid work, peak memory and serving against all capable references. No speed superiority follows from parameter storage or asymptotics.
gates.failure: Any primary accuracy/member gate failure closes this exact recipe. No rescue ordering, gate, width, residual, coefficient, split or horizon grid. Preserve every arm and failure. A positive development result prioritizes unused coherent confirmation.

diagnostics: Raw/calibrated pooled accuracy,NLL,Brier/ECE; each route/view accuracy and NLL; independently selected I4/WI4 body horizons.

Relative to I4,WI4,PV1,V1 and S4: repaired and introduced errors; correct-member/view coverage C; covered-but-pooled-wrong loss L; no-member-correct-but-pooled-right A. Check delta_correct=delta_C-delta_L+delta_A. Hidden distances and scan gates are descriptive only.
Export every fixed arm's complete selected model/member or view predictions, per-block metrics, selection law/costs, before interpretation.

tied_four_tour_aggregation.PV1: Ordinary source parameters θ, including bias, and scanner maps are identical across all four views.
tied_four_tour_aggregation.V1: A single native factor/bias parameter set and scanner maps θ are identical across all four views.
tied_four_tour_aggregation.training: For each j=0..3, use θ and source view-j dropout stream to compute H_j, scan on tour j, Hprime_j and final native logits z_j. No hidden averaging at any layer. Objective=(1/4)*sum_j CE(y_TRAIN,softmax(z_j))+one native penalty(θ). One optimizer and mean-total SELECT selector.
tied_four_tour_aggregation.serving: Disable dropout. Compute four separate tour residuals and four final logits using the same θ; p(v;T)=(1/4)*sum_j softmax(log_softmax(z_j(v))/T). No hidden averaging or loss on averaged probabilities. Calibration learns one scalar T after selected-state restore.
tied_four_tour_aggregation.cache: At evaluation common H and node u/a may be computed once, then each tour scan/residual/final native layer runs separately. Any caching is reported in paid work.
tied_four_tour_aggregation.factory_caution: PV1/V1 must each construct ONE native Body with one parameter/bias set (and one factor set for V1), then execute it over four view contexts. A nonfactor Body(members=4) in the reused core has four private bias rows and is NOT PV1. Runtime logical views4 must not imply trainable member-axis parameters.

genuine_equipped_I4_ownership.WI4: Four distinct factorized native bodies plus four complete distinct scanner parameter sets, each learner with own native penalty, optimizer, selector, stop, selected state and source RNG streams. Body m scans only tour m in TRAIN, SELECT and serving. Mean final probabilities over the four independently selected bodies.
genuine_equipped_I4_ownership.view_count: One view per body, FOUR total scan contexts across the bank, equal to SW4 total contexts. This does not equip each body with all four tours.
genuine_equipped_I4_ownership.later_reference_gap: If the pilot is useful, an independent bank whose EVERY body processes all four tours remains a stronger missing capable reference before promoting an ensemble-superiority claim. The ordinary PV1 and factorized V1 arms already test all four views in a single tied learner. Root fixes later unused-evidence comparison before its outcomes; no extra pilot arm is added.
genuine_equipped_I4_ownership.later_reference_recipe: Each of four genuine bodies ties its own parameters across the same four tours, optimizes mean own-view CE plus one own native penalty, selects/stops independently, and serves mean probabilities across16 body-view computations. Bodies remain wholly unshared.
genuine_equipped_I4_ownership.later_reference_cost: Same trainable parameter storage as four corresponding equipped single bodies;16 total scan contexts instead of4. Node projection/first-layer caching at evaluation can reduce shared work within each body, but cannot remove16 scans/final branches. TRAIN uses own persistent streams per view. No numerical execution or scheduling authorization.

decision_after_complete_peer: Keep the fixed Rademacher native initialization. Peer full closure establishes a competent source sharing comparator. All-ones starts remain an inactive separate combination. The source-preserving graph residual and distinct traversal histories are the ONE nominated architectural acquisition mechanism.
